title: Decent Soap Dispenser but Stainless It’s Not
text:
Decent Soap Dispenser but Stainless It’s Not. I appreciate the aesthetics of this soap dispenser as it matches the rest of my bathroom accessories. It has an inner plastic container, it holds a fairly large amount of soap and the pump works well.

The finish is not the nicest I’ve seen and mine had 3 small blemishes straight out of the box - 1 gouge and 2 small scratches.

After using for one complete cycle of filling with soup it developed a brown rust colored oxidation where the pump meets the body of the dispenser. I was able to scrub it off but it took some scrubbing.

This would be much better with a better top coat on the stainless but it works well and I appreciate the size and shape.

Thanks for reading my review. I enjoy writing them as I value reading other’s reviews when I’m making a buying decision. I regularly update my reviews to reflect any changes I may discover and to include helpful tips you may need if you purchase the product. I will always make every effort to answer any questions I can as it is my pleasure to help.
